notes.title: New Target Release: 2025
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247220/19637eda476cc8ecae498543ea4518bc31d97ebb.jpg

We have decided to revise the release schedule for “Rommel in the Republic ~ Operation Weichsel ~”, currently in development, with the aim of further polishing the game.  
The new target release window is now set for In 2025.

We are working hard to create a more strategic gameplay experience, and we hope you’ll continue to look forward to it.

Period Games
